tools.description: Sets the clock time the trip home leaves the shelter town and arrives back at the home street. Use it when a clock time for the trip home is being fixed. Do not use it for food stops or for how long a visit lasts. Times use a 24-hour clock.

tools.description: Adds a short food stop to the afternoon plan before the trip home. Use it when a place to eat or buy food during the day is being requested. Do not use it for the shelter visit or for setting the return time. Stops are chosen from a fixed list of nearby places.

tools.description: Searches for the nearest place of a given type around the current location. Use it when someone asks where the closest shop or service of some kind is. Do not use it to start navigation or to book a ride. It returns search results only and does not change the route.
